title: A Weather for the Silence
author: Rafael Brightwater
blurb: Wren Brightwater, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the house sale closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
